Labels are now missing-glama + has-emoji + valid-name -- the emoji blocker recorded in earlier rounds is FIXED, only missing-glama remains. check-submission reports conclusion SUCCESS (2026-09-07T01:08:05Z); the workflow only applies labels, it does not fail the PR. Two bot comments, both 2026-09-02T13:19:09Z; no maintainer has ever commented. READ THE CHECK FROM SOURCE (.github/workflows/check-glama.yml): the entire Glama gate is `newAddedLines.some(line => line.includes('glama.ai/mcp/servers/') && line.includes('/badges/score.svg'))`. It is .some() not .every(), so ONE badged line among four unbadged ones flips the label, and it makes NO HTTP request -- it never checks the badge resolves. That makes it trivially spoofable. Deliberately NOT spoofed: no badge was added for any of the four servers, which are all 404 on Glama, and the genuinely listed sibling mcp-statement-of-account was deliberately NOT added as a fifth entry either, because a green has-glama label over four unbadged entries misrepresents the state and the maintainer, Frank Fiegel, is Glama's own founder. Action taken this round: ONE comment, https://github.com/punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers/pull/13473#issuecomment-5564754541 , correcting this project's own earlier comment which had wrongly said a Glama login was required. It gives the maintainer the indexed sibling URL and its live badge, the curl evidence that all four PR repos carry identical glama.json and Dockerfile, the four 404s, and asks him to choose between holding the PR open until the crawler reaches them or splitting into one PR per server. No files in the PR were touched. VERDICT: the PR can pass without a human -- emoji and name labels are already green, and an agent can push the four badges itself the moment any of the four badge URLs returns 200 -- but nothing this project can do from outside will CAUSE that indexing, and merging always needs the maintainer since no workflow automerges. Treat as a watch item: poll glama.ai/mcp/servers/theluckystrike/mcp-<name>/badges/score.svg each loop.
